commits.subject: feat(core): generator-expression factories wrap in destructuring-slot defaults - rfc 20260729-fn-value-any v4 knife 1: a destr default holding a hoisted __genexpr_* factory (the t262 fn-name-gen template family, 186 of the 291 box_to_any residue) had no wrap axis and the raw FnSig panicked the whole program; the collector now marks dstr_default_names entries with the synthetic prefix (user code cannot spell it, so no shadow risk), accepting the same intrinsic-chain trade the any-call-arg axis has always made - the assembled case runs to its .name assert (the NamedEvaluation thread through dstr_default_names is the registered follow-up) and generator-fn-intrinsics-001 holds

chore(docs,hardev): rotation 244 census stamp and sweep archive - passTotal +392 with bug -153 as the v2b expression-default materialization turns a bug family into passes, box_to_any FnSig 355 to 291, four honest-fail exposures in the iter-get-err family, dashboard refresh

refactor(core): optional-default synthesis converges into a param_optional_default sibling - the three inline guards pushed param_list.rs to 521 (over the 500 hard cap rotation 227's watch predicted; the per-commit audit missed the file axis) - the shared implicit_optional_default method brings it back to 497 and parse_fn to 415

fix(core): an absent any-slot optional parameter binds undefined, not null - es 9.2: the three optional-param synthesis sites (parse_fn, the ctor param list, parse_param_list for methods and fn-exprs) minted an implicit Expr::Null default, so typeof b answered object and b === undefined false on every omitted optional (probe-caught alongside the v2b work); an any / un-annotated optional now mints the undefined ident while a typed optional keeps the legacy implicit null - its __nullable(T) slot has no undefined arm (registered)

feat(core): ctor-init receivers lose the typed-ident wrap exemption - rfc 20260729-fn-value-any v1b: the v1 axis exempted every non-any-annotated ident receiver to protect typed hof fast paths, but an UN-annotated binding whose init is a constructor call (let f = new foo(); f.every(cb) - the largest box_to_any FnSig residue shape at 64 Array/prototype cases) is a dynobj whose method calls ride the runtime any-method lane; a new collect walks let-inits for __new_/__fnctor_ factory calls (the binding walker generalizes to carry ann-less bindings and the init ExprId) and the exemption skips those names, so the fn-name argument wraps and the case reaches the runtime instead of the whole-program panic

fix(core): expression-default materialize runs before the closure lift and skips arrow-bearing defaults - the gate caught the first cut orphaning a moved IIFE default from the capture machinery (closure capture cc not in scope): the pass now runs as its own pipeline stage right after desugar_classes so a moved default rides bind_this_param / lift_arrow_fns like any body expression, and a recursive whitelist keeps arrow-bearing defaults on the call-site pad - a closure minted inside a fn body cannot capture a top-level let today (pre-existing, registered), while the padded copy at the top-level call site works

feat(core): expression parameter defaults materialize in the callee body - rfc 20260729-fn-value-any v2b: call-site padding cannot express a default that references the callee scope (padding f(x, y = x) with the ExprId of x either rejected the whole program on the solo-name shape or silently bound the implicit fill when the by-name merge bailed - probes showed c.m(9) answering null where the spec owes 9), so a new materialize pass run at the head of apply_default_args rewrites every any/unannotated expression default per es 9.2 into a body-head guard (if (y === undefined) y = x, callee scope, param order, ahead of a destructured param's unpack prefix) and leaves an undefined literal as the pad value; the s2.38 this-free verdict accepts that literal, which closes the detached-generator-method chain end to end (the t262 dflt-params-ref-prior assembled case now runs to AsyncTestComplete); typed expression defaults keep their loud reject

chore(docs,hardev): rotation 243 census stamp and sweep archive - re-swept at the fix-up head 6397d916, passTotal +999 with the async-iteration walls closed (rfc gen-forof-yieldstar complete, box_to_any FnSig 720 to 355), 85 v2a static regressions caught mid-close and reverted, dashboard refresh

fix(core): static generator methods keep the this-passing forwarder - rotation 243 sweep caught 85 async-gen-meth-static-* pass regressions from v2a: a static forwarder that stops mentioning this breaks the __sm_<C>__<m> static-member alias chain (let m = C.method lowered to an unknown __sm_ ident or a whole-program generic-arity reject), so the receiver-free relaxation now applies to instance methods only; the static value-use face keeps its previous path until that chain gets its own lane

feat(core): detached generator method values run bare when the body is receiver-free - rfc 20260729-fn-value-any v2a: parse_class_decl_generator sweeps the body's expr range for the minted __genrecv ident (this and super rewrites are its only two sources), and a receiver-free body relaxes the synth generator's receiver ann to any and passes undefined instead of this through the forwarder - which makes the forwarder itself this-free, so the existing s2.38 metadata pass stamps FLAG_CLASS_METHOD_THIS_FREE and a detached C.prototype.m bare call (the t262 class dflt-params template family's shape) constructs the generator object instead of the receiver-undefined TypeError; a this-reading generator method keeps its nominal receiver ann and normal path

feat(core): fn-name arguments box through their forwarder on untyped member-call receivers - rfc 20260729-fn-value-any v1: a top-fndecl ident passed to a member call whose receiver is an any-bound ident or any chained expression (the t262 async harness .then($DONE, $DONE) tail - the shared trigger of the whole 720-case box_to_any FnSig cluster) now wraps as Closure{__forward_<name>} through the existing fn-to-closure axis family, so the any-method argv gets a boxed closure cell instead of the raw FnSig loud panic; a typed ident receiver keeps its args on raw-FnSig direct dispatch so xs.map(topFn) hot paths are untouched

feat(core): async yield* and for-await inside async generator bodies - f3 closes the rfc 20260728-gen-forof-yieldstar async half on top of the for-await-any kernel: the f1 manual-protocol rewrite accepts is_await and drives it with the async taps (getiterator hint=async via an @@asyncIterator probe ternary falling to the sync symbol per getmethod nullish, awaited next() so an async iterator's promise-shaped step settles before done/value per 14.7.5.6, awaited value for the async-from-sync lane per 27.1.4.4), the generic yield* desugar stamps is_await from in_async_gen so the async refusal retires, and the j.3 typed lane gates off in async generators (an async inner's next() answers promise-shaped steps the typed expansion would read unsettled)
